data.Name: Glowing Sword in a Rock
data.Description: A magnificent sword juts from a boulder, glowing with ethereal light. Dramatic choir music plays from an unknown source. A queue of failed adventurers sits nearby eating sandwiches and watching. One of them has a betting pool going.
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The sword pulses invitingly. The choir music intensifies. Someone in the audience eats popcorn loudly.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Pull the Sword", "risk": 0.5, "success": {"type": "draw_card", "text": "You pull it free with a dramatic flourish! The crowd cheers! You look down. It's... a butter knife. A very shiny, magical butter knife. The choir music stops with a record scratch.", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}, "failure": {"type": "damage_player", "damage": 8, "text": "The rock EXPLODES! The sword was load-bearing! Chunks of rock fly everywhere! The audience holds up score cards: 3.5, 4.0, 2.0. Harsh crowd."}}, {"name": "Leave It Alone", "risk": 0.0, "effect": {"type": "none", "text": "Probably cursed anyway. You walk away with dignity. The sword dims sadly. The choir does a disappointed 'awwww.' The audience boos."}}]}}, {"probability": 0.30, "type": "none", "text": "Another adventurer pulls it out while you were deciding. It's a spoon. A legendary, world-renowned, destiny-fulfilling spoon. They seem thrilled.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "none", "text": "The sword pulls itself out, stretches, says 'finally!' and walks away on tiny legs. Nobody in the audience seems surprised.", "params": {}}, {"probability": 0.15, "type": "draw_card", "text": "The rock crumbles from age and the sword clatters to the ground. You pick it up before anyone else can. It's not magical but it IS shiny.", "params": {"card_type": "Junk Card"}}]
